Azamat Jauysh bridges two disciplines rarely combined in one engineer:
1. **Commercial Multimodal & Neuro-Symbolic AI SaaS Engineering**: FastAPI (Python 3.12), Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Gemini 2.5 Flash Vision / GPT-4o, PostgreSQL 16 (Serializable isolation & BYTEA streaming), Redis 7 + BullMQ, Google Cloud Run, and Zero-Trust B2B paywalls.

## 3. Detailed Case Studies Catalog (13 Production Systems)

### [01] Auto-Tender — AI GovTech, 4-Layer Spec Verifier & Global Sourcing Terminal
- **Internal Case Study**: `https://niaz.kz/en/projects/auto-tender`
- **Problem**: B2B suppliers waste hours reading PDF technical specs across 5 procurement portals, risk 24-month RNU blacklisting from hidden traps, hit API rate-limit bans, and suffer from LLM price hallucinations.
- **Architecture**:
  - **5-Layer GoszakupAntiBanGuard**: Semaphore(1), human jitter, Circuit Breaker, dedicated KZ IPv4 Proxy, and Supabase PostgreSQL caching (`0.005s` reads, `0%` ban risk).
  - **4-Layer Neuro-Symbolic AI Verification**: PyMuPDF PDF Evidence Quote grounding + Serper regional/1688/Alibaba factory search + deterministic `temperature=0.0` Gemini 2.5 Judge + autonomous Reflexion retry loop.
  - **3-Tab Terminal**: Active multi-portal lots, 6–12 month Pre-RFP `/v3/plans` budget forecasting, and HS-Code customs OEM supply chain graph with 411+ verified tender winners CRM.
  - **Security & Monetization**: DevTools-proof server-side DEMO redaction, Web-First Email OTP + Telegram WebApp HMAC-SHA256 auth, anti-sharing device limits, and multi-rail B2B billing.

### [02] OmniCheck — Agentic AI Homework Grading & Mastery Recovery SaaS
- **Internal Case Study**: `https://niaz.kz/en/projects/omnicheck`
- **Problem**: Manual grading of handwritten STEM notebooks consumes 10–15h/week per teacher without resolving underlying student concept gaps, while raw photo uploads expose student PII to external LLMs.
- **Architecture**:
  - **4 Adaptive Workspace Modes & 6-Tier RBAC**: Tailored UX for Solo Teachers, Tutoring Centers, Single Schools, and Multi-Branch School Networks across 6 locales (including RTL).
  - **Autonomous Pedagogical Loop (Auto-Pilot & Co-Pilot)**: `Concept Gap` diagnosis → interactive Socratic `Mastery Recovery` → teacher 3-problem `Morning Warm-up` → parent jargon-free `Compassionate Briefing`.
  - **Client-Side GDPR Privacy Shield & Perceptual dHash**: Browser HTML5 Canvas compresses 15MB scans to ~250KB and redacts the top 7% PII header prior to upload; Sharp 64-bit `dHash` flags peer copying in `<1s`.

### [03] Core SIS — Central K-12 Student Information System & Unified API Gateway
- **Internal Case Study**: `https://niaz.kz/en/projects/core-sis`
- **Architecture**: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 Single Source of Truth (`Proxmox CT 107`) consolidating **481 legacy paper/Excel forms (72 document groups)** across 8 units into **9 relational modules** (`core`, `hr`, `students`, `admissions`, `finance`, `academics`, `olympiads`, `events_pr`, `assets_docs`), with strict Google SSO allowlist RBAC, 24h auto-suspend IAM lifecycle, quadrilingual (`RO/RU/TR/EN`) A4 official document generation, and a unified REST API Gateway.

### [04] LuminaMath — High-Concurrency National Math Olympiad Engine
- **Internal Case Study**: `https://niaz.kz/en/projects/luminamath`
- **Architecture**: Auto-scaling Google Cloud Run (`1,200` concurrent request capacity, `700+` peak simultaneous users), atomic PostgreSQL 6-digit candidate ID upserts, in-memory JSZip bulk admin matching into stateless PostgreSQL `BYTEA` OMR PDF streaming (`<1 ms` B-Tree lookup, 120s RAM cache), PIN lockout, and Google-only OAuth 2.0 admin SSO.

### [05] EduStaff IAM — Multi-Campus HR, Olympiad Registry & Workspace Portal
- **Internal Case Study**: `https://niaz.kz/en/projects/hr-orizont`
- **Architecture**: Ultra-lean (`~27 MB` RAM, `13.3 ms` TTFB behind Nginx WAF) Next.js + SQLite/JSON platform (`CT 106`) unifying **582 synced staff IAM records**, 239 public faculty portfolios, 1-click Google Workspace offboarding, expat visa watchdogs, the **1996–2026 Olympiad Medal Registry & printable QR-verified A4 diplomas**, and strict PII-stripping public APIs.

### [06] GM-App — Multi-Campus Executive Admissions MIS & Outreach CRM
